issue.title: Keep a typed / literal after album routes and open the record list
issue.description: In Bob Mac Capture, typing `/` right after an album route such as `@eat` inserts a literal `/` (the `@eat/` record route) instead of the `/` → `#` capture alias, an explicit `#` still opens the section menu, and a draft that is only `@eat/` immediately lists that album's existing record notes.
issue.creation_reason: Approved epic plan plan:202611/album_slash_record_list.md requests this work

payload.entry: capture-rewrite keeps / literal after album routes. Verified: unit tests (AlbumValid/AlbumInvalid stay /, Unclaimed/DiscoveryIncomplete/no-policy still #, @eat/ still collapses, @eat# tip is null while @dev# still teaches /); CLI tests (album vault @eat/ unchanged with null tip, @notes/ still @notes#, @eat# null tip, missing vault @eat/ still @eat# and does not create the directory); live BOB_DIR probe of @eat/, @eat#, and @dev/; just lint, just docs-check, and cargo fmt --check. Glossary capture-alias updated; docs-gen refreshed CLI help and glossary.md.
